perfil_anterior.problema: SECURE IIOT DATA SHARING ACROSS ORGANIZATIONS
perfil_anterior.possibilidades: Integrar identidade autossoberana (SSI) para gerenciamento de credenciais de dispositivos IIoT; avaliar desempenho em ambientes de alta latência e redes heterogêneas; estender o modelo para suportar revogação e recuperação de credenciais perdidas usando criptografia homomórfica; adaptar o framework para interoperabilidade com padrões de cidades inteligentes e serviços públicos digitais.

entrada.texto:
ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
I would like to express my sincere gratitude to all the people who supported me directly
and indirectly during the stages of this project.
In particular, to my parents, Claudio Souza Costa and Angelita Novaes Fioreze Costa, who
sacrificed and motivated me in my academic journey since my childhood. They always instilled
confidence, enthusiasm, faith, and love in me. I would also like to honor the memory of my
brother who, although no longer with us to witness this, was the first person to encourage
me to study Technology in my adolescence. I am also deeply grateful to my partner, Ta ´ıs
Alves Silva Ribeiro, for her motivation and patience throughout this project, as well as for her
encouragement to persevere even during turbulent times. The trust you placed in this process
was part of what made it possible.
I also express my deep gratitude to the Federal University of S ˜ao Paulo, an institution I
always wanted to be a part of and to which I am proud to belong.
And finally, my sincere thanks to my esteemed advisors, Prof. Dr. Arlindo Flavio da
Conceic ¸˜ao and Prof. Dr. Vladimir Rocha, for their guidance, patience, and support in the
development of this project. Both are great examples for me.
Thank you.

resposta.resumo: O autor agradece aos pais, irmão, parceira, à Universidade Federal de São Paulo e aos orientadores Prof. Dr. Arlindo Flavio da Conceição e Prof. Dr. Vladimir Rocha pelo apoio ao desenvolvimento da dissertação.

perfil.problema: SECURE IIOT DATA SHARING ACROSS ORGANIZATIONS
perfil.possibilidades: Explorar a integração de SSI com o framework ABE para gerenciamento de credenciais de dispositivos IIoT em cidades inteligentes, avaliando revogação baseada em atributos e uso de criptografia homomórfica para processamento seguro de dados.
